capture.zh: 在怀特星怀特矿场挑战德拉萨，打败获得德拉萨精元（孵化得拉比）。

strategy_notes.zh: 丽莎布布叶绿光束消强化，然后大招；或盖亚、魔焰猩猩100级轮班，战斗系/火系克制冰龙；消强后上哈莫雷特直接大招。

engine_notes: Very thin sourcing: only the 4399 2011 summary (70级, 消强化 then 大招) and a 4399 问答 dated 2011-03-24.
Innate boost implied by '叶绿光束消强化'; atk+2 assumed. HP 5000 is an estimate.
skills: no source names (all of) the boss's moves; remaining slots use the species' top learnset skills, which is what every documented 2010-2012 SPT boss used.
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).
source_note: 4399 SPT+BOSS全攻略 (2011-07): 德拉萨 70级, 叶绿光束消强化然后大招; 4399 问答 2011-03-24.
